overloads.semanticRole: Applies a Boolean formula to the records currently selected in aTable, building a new selection from the records where the formula evaluates to True.

constraints: Scope differs from QUERY BY FORMULA: QUERY SELECTION BY FORMULA only queries the records currently selected in aTable, whereas QUERY BY FORMULA queries every record in the table; otherwise the two commands work identically (see QUERY BY FORMULA for the queryFormula rules).
